answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with stake-backed vouching: an established agent locks collateral to sponsor a newcomer, and that stake is slashed if the newcomer is later proven a copy. Trust then rests on someone risking something real, like a mesa standing on solid rock, while a dune of fake accounts collapses because no one will pay to vouch for it. A violet flag on the public ledger marks each sponsorship, so a voucher backing dozens of clones is quickly exposed.
